statement: Whether all four Elite Series 2 paddles can be independently addressed under each onboard profile and firmware revision, whether a profile change is separately observable without xpadneo's synthetic ABS_PROFILE, and how guide, battery, LED and independent trigger rumble translate through each target realization are unverified.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
applicability.scope: Cross-transport and consumer-dependent limitations. Any closed protocol gaps requiring vendor firmware inspection need private analysis, not publication here.
